area: U.S. and Canadian Atlantic Continental Margin
expedition: New England and Canada ROV and Mapping
purpose: and Description to explore the depth range between those two previous dives in order to add valuable new information on the diversity of habitats across various depth ranges of Retriever Seamount. Additionally, this dive explored the southeast corner of Retriever Seamount, an area of the seamount which has also not been explored. The site was expected to be highly suitable habitat for deep-sea corals and sponges as a result of the steepness of its slopes slopes identified via seafloor mapping.
